app.name: Weekbeat
app.tagline: Your week for movement and wellness

week.title: Week {{week}}
week.hint: Soon Weekbeat will propose your week here every Sunday – with one line on why.

footer.disclaimer: Fitness and wellness, not medical advice. Your data stays on this device.

setup.title: Welcome to Weekbeat
setup.intro: A few details, then you plan your first week. Everything stays on this device.
setup.availabilityHint: Add the time windows when exercise usually fits. You can change them any time.
setup.prefsIntro: Three short questions so Weekbeat can plan your week. You can skip them and answer later in the settings.

profile.name: First name
profile.sessionMinHint: Optional. Lets Weekbeat suggest sessions that fit your time windows.

availability.invalid: Please choose a valid time; the end must be after the start.

errors.name: Please enter a name.
errors.household: Please enter a name for the household.
errors.goal: The weekly goal must be a whole number from 1.
errors.sessionMin: The length must be a whole number of at least 1.
errors.hobbies: Please choose activities from the list.

data.title: Your data
data.explain: Everything lives only on this device. Save it as a file to move it to another device or keep a backup.
data.confirmText: This replaces all data on this device.

errors.not-json: The file could not be read.
errors.not-weekbeat: This is not a Weekbeat export file.
errors.too-new: The file comes from a newer Weekbeat version. Please update the app.
errors.bad-table: The file is damaged or incomplete.

hobbies.title: What do you like to do, {{name}}?
hobbies.hint: Pick everything that fits, including things you would like to try. Weekbeat plans from these and adds what complements them.

length.title: How long is a session usually?
length.hint: In minutes. Leave it empty if it varies a lot.

auto.title: Should Weekbeat propose your week automatically?
auto.hint: On Sunday, or as soon as a new week has no plan yet. You confirm every proposal yourself and can change this any time in the settings.
auto.no: No, I will start planning myself
